Stable checkpoint workflow: fully stop Halo/XeniOS, reopen this launcher, then Save. Restore is also launcher-only. Uses Halo Reach\'s real autosave—not an emulator save state.
Live diagnostic Save/Restore quiesces the running emulator. Keep XeniOS open until the operation completes.

This copies Halo Reach\'s real cache1 autosave only. It cannot save an arbitrary paused frame. Continue only after Halo displayed a stable checkpoint, autosave activity finished, and you fully stopped and restarted XeniOS.
